system.bonus: Once per long rest you may spend a DP to reduce the tension die by 1 step (d12 to d10, d10 to d8, etc). for the duration of a single encounter or scene (GM determines when a scene changes). After the encounter or scene the tension die returns to its previous value. Multiple characters can de-escalate the same encounter or scene, but the die may not be reduced below 1d4.
